cases.criterion: Valid registration and sign-in work; invalid details produce feedback.

cases.criterion: Selected visibility is enforced for another viewer.

cases.criterion: Application records contribution and availability; duplicate active applications prevented.

cases.actual: Minimum 20-character error; submission and Activity status shown; Apply absent. Direct duplicate requests untested.
cases.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

cases.actual: Withdrawn history and disabled Closed action observed. Direct backend attempts untested.
cases.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

cases.criterion: Owner can shortlist/remove candidates; membership must remain unchanged.
cases.scenario: Shortlist status and membership invariant
cases.steps: Fajer's application exists. Afnan reviews, shortlists, removes and shortlists again. Compare displayed vacancies and student status; inspect membership records.
cases.expected: Status tracks changes; no membership created; team capacity unchanged.
cases.actual: Status changes and student Shortlisted confirmed; UI counts unchanged. Membership records not inspected because Firebase testing is deferred.
cases.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

cases.requirement: US04, US05, US07 / FR05, FR06, FR09
cases.criterion: Expired events are identified; linked recruitment must not invite applications after expiry.
cases.scenario: Parent event expiry propagated to linked request UI
cases.steps: Existing linked request. Afnan changes parent dates to 1-2 Oct; Fajer opens parent and request, then taps Apply.
cases.expected: Parent marked ended; linked request closes or prevents entering application flow.
cases.actual: Parent Event ended; linked request shows revised dates but Apply remains enabled and form opens. No application sent.
cases.method: Manual interaction through the running Android UI

cases.requirement: US03, US06, US07, US08 / FR04, FR07, FR09, FR10
cases.criterion: An owner publishes recruitment; another student discovers and applies; the owner reviews and shortlists.
cases.scenario: Complete recruitment journey
cases.steps: Two dedicated accounts. Afnan publishes the Campus Collaboration project. Fajer discovers it and submits a contribution with 6 hours/week. Afnan signs in, opens applicants, reviews Fajer and shortlists. Fajer signs back in and checks Activity.
cases.expected: Project discoverable; application visible to owner; shortlist state visible to student.
cases.actual: All UI stages completed; Fajer's Activity displayed Shortlisted. This result covers the UI journey, not database membership or direct-request authorization.
cases.method: Manual system test on Samsung SM-G960W
